title: Construct K Palindrome Strings
description: Given a lowercase string `s` and an integer `k`, return `true` if you can use every character in `s` to construct exactly `k` non-empty palindrome strings, and `false` otherwise.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: You cannot form more non-empty strings than there are characters in s.
Each character with an odd frequency must serve as the center of a distinct palindrome, so oddCount <= k is both necessary and sufficient.

examples.explanation: We can form "anna" and "elble" using all characters.
"leetcode" has 5 odd-frequency letters, so 3 palindromes cannot absorb them all.
Each single character can be its own palindrome when k == len(s).
